role: Test double for the StrapRadio protocol (Polar SDK surface): scripted strap that records every call in order, serves queued HR samples, H10 exercises and Verity offline PPI recordings, and can refuse N times or hang specific calls, so strap arming/fetch/night sequences run in unit tests.
types: FakeStrapRadio: class (StrapRadio, @unchecked Sendable) — scripted fake strap
FakeStrapRadio.Call: enum — one recorded app→strap call (16 cases)
FakeStrapRadio.OfflineRow: struct — Sendable listing row (path, date)
FakeStrapRadio.State: struct — all scripted state (calls, recording flags, exercises, offline entries/data, HR/PPI queues, refusals, hanging calls)
toplevel: Imports PolarBleSdk unconditionally (the production protocol is inside #if canImport(PolarBleSdk)); State defaults: no calls, no recording, empty queues.

units.does: Runs body with exclusive access to the State under the NSLock and returns its result.
Returns a snapshot of the recorded call list.
Returns the peripheral ids passed to each startHrStreaming call.
Scripts the H10 recording status (ongoing flag and entry id).
Adds an H10 exercise entry (path/date/entryId) and its RR data (interval 1, samples rrMs).
Adds a Verity offline listing row and PPI offline data at path, one sample per ppiMs value (hr 60, skin contact on).
Sets the offline-recording ongoing flag for a feature (default .ppi).
Queues one HR sample batch (bpm, rrsMs, rrAvailable = rrs non-empty) to be yielded by startHrStreaming.
Makes the named call fail `times` times with error (default PolarErrors.notificationNotEnabled); the error is shared by all refusals.
Marks the named call as hanging forever.
If call is marked hanging, suspends forever on a never-resumed UnsafeContinuation (ignores cancellation); otherwise returns.

branches.effect: true: never returns; false: returns immediately

units.does: Returns the scripted refusal error and decrements the remaining count when refusals remain for call; else nil.

branches.effect: true: decrements and returns refusalError; false: nil

units.does: Records .removeOfflineRecord(path); under the lock, finds every listing row whose path shares the entry's recording key (the whole recording directory), drops their offlineData and removes them from the listing, so later listings and getOfflineRecord no longer see the recording. Throws PolarErrors.deviceError("no such recording") when no row matched — a second removal for the same recording fails, as the sensor does.

branches.cond: removed (some row matched the recording key)
branches.effect: false: throws PolarErrors.deviceError(description: "no such recording"); true: returns
